lines.t: In these Seven is wisdom and understanding, the very mind of God. For the Holy Days are revelation, revealing hidden things kept secret since the world began - signposts of things to come, a foretaste of The Kingdom, a glimpse into the Glory of God even as the Scriptures, unfolding and coming to light as the will of God is manifest, says The Lord.
Salvation assured, sin and death overcome, the Spirit given.
Sin destroyed, evil bound, My seat taken, Judgment...
A new day, even one thousand years...
An everlasting day in The Lord!
